slides.title: Demoing the power tools
slides.lead: We're going to take a tour through the Claude CLI, MCP, Hugging Face, and Ollama. Feel free to follow along if you have your own device — and remember you can also try some of these tools later on our new CHDR Spark.

slides.title: The Twilight of the Chatbots
slides.note: Substack sends frame-ancestors CSP, so the embed renders blank; the HTML adds a fallback open-in-new-tab caption link.

slides.title: Altman: 'jobs that aren't real work'
bullets: [tomshardware.com](https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/sam-altman-says-ai-could-eliminate-jobs-that-arent-real-work): the CEO's framing of which jobs disappear.
Whose work is 'not real'? Look at the verbs.
Most of what humanists do is on his list.

slides.quote: The point of bullshit jobs isn't that the work is hard or the workers are lazy. It's that the work is *meaningless*, and the worker knows it. AI is being marketed as the cure. It is at least as likely to be a more efficient producer.
slides.attribution: Echoing David Graeber's *I Had to Guard an Empty Room*

slides.title: Claude CLI
slides.note: [Installation directions](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/quickstart). Easiest way to use: select **Repository → Open in Command Prompt** (or Terminal) from GitHub Desktop and type `claude`.

slides.title: Commands
bullets: **Slash commands:** type `/` for the menu — `/init`, `/help`, `/model`, and friends.
**Shift+Tab:** cycles the modes — normal, auto-accept, and plan mode.

slides.title: Installing an MCP server
bullets: **Example one:** the [Hugging Face plugin](https://huggingface.co/mcp) — models, datasets, and Spaces inside Claude.
**Example two:** the [Zotero MCP](https://github.com/54yyyu/zotero-mcp) — your research library shares a context with your writing.

slides.title: Claude CLI running local models
slides.note: Using Superpowers, we'll describe the project, have Claude select the best local model for audio transcription, and build an interface for our transcription tool.

slides.title: Ollama
slides.note: [Installation](https://ollama.com/download) — then the Claude Code CLI with Ollama: a local model driving the same power tool (a less competent agent).

slides.title: Where will this take you?
slides.lead: All of these tools seem to be on a trajectory of growing more powerful — and potentially more expensive. But local models are also rising in capability.
